mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MSGS ( MSG_ID, ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, CONTENT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MSG_ID.NEXTVAL, #{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{message} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'TALK' as type, M.ROOM_ID as roomId, M.SENDER_ID as senderId, U.USER_NAME as senderName, M.CONTENT as message FROM CHAT_MSGS M JOIN USERS U ON M.SENDER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY M.MSG_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 100 ORDER BY roomId ASC
